entries.title: One-command add and a zero-backend contribution path
items: `tools/add-repo.py` adds a repo in one command: it refuses private, archived or already-listed repos, reads license, latest release and topics, writes the entry with today's date, appends the changelog entry, rebuilds every generated file and runs both link checks.

The site now has an **Add repo** button: paste the link, pick a group, and it opens a prefilled GitHub issue. `add-repo.yml` turns that issue into a branch and a pull request through the same tool; it never trusts the issue for anything but the URL and the group.

`validate.yml` gates every pull request: catalog and changelog validation, a stale-generated-file diff, `check-links.py` and `check-repos.py`. A PR with hand-edited or stale `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` or `docs/index.html` cannot merge.
`tools/issue-payload.py` parses the issue body; `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/add-repo.md` is the manual form of the same three fields.

entries.title: ScreenStreamerXR added
items: Added BlueScorpioVR/ScreenStreamerXR to Apps & Samples (issue #1).

entries.title: AstroQuest back in the catalog
items: Restored evertec82/AstroQuest to Games & Emulation. It had answered 404 from three independent checks — the GitHub API, shields.io and a signed-in browser — and was removed; it answers again, so the card is back.

Its release badge now reads v0.8.6 (Game 1.04 soccer timing fix, 2026-10-14). Every other catalogued repo was re-checked the same way: 54 of 54 are present, none renamed, transferred, archived or gone.

entries.title: Filter figures now count what each filter would show
items: Every number in the filters panel is computed from the current selection: group counts follow the search box and the active status filters, status counts also follow the chosen group, and each status chip counts the repositories it would leave on screen.
Fixed: collapsing the panel wrapped the repo grid into a second grid row and pushed the whole catalog down the page — the collapsed track now shrinks to zero instead of dropping out of the grid.
Fixed: on desktop the panel no longer closes when a card is clicked; the Filters button and Escape close it, and the phone drawer keeps its backdrop click.

entries.title: AstroQuest removed; badge errors no longer print
items: Removed evertec82/AstroQuest from Games & Emulation: the repository is gone now (GitHub answers 404), so its card linked nowhere.

Site cards no longer print an error word as a figure: when shields.io answers "invalid" or another error string, that badge is hidden rather than showing the word, the string is never cached, and the value is retried once the cache expires.
A release pill now only appears for repositories the catalog gives a single release stream, so the live lookup can no longer add one to a card built without a release badge.

entries.title: Filters menu opens as a glass dropdown
items: The filter panel is frosted glass now: translucent gradient, blur and saturation backdrop filter, hairline border and a deep shadow, with an opaque fallback on browsers without backdrop-filter.
Opening and closing is pure CSS — fade, drop and a slight scale from the top-left corner, sliding in the same panel on phones — and the panel closes on Escape or a click outside it, like a dropdown.

entries.title: Filters rail moves out to the left on wide screens
items: Site layout: from 1840px up the filter rail leaves the centered column and sits to its left with a fixed 26px gap — closer to the window edge, but never flush against it.
The width the rail frees goes to the repository grid, which shows three cards per row there; narrower screens keep the previous layout.

entries.title: Orange cursor glow
items: The site now carries a soft orange glow that eases toward the pointer: one fixed radial-gradient layer moved with a composited transform in a single requestAnimationFrame loop.
The glow is skipped on touch devices and for reduced-motion visitors, and its loop stops when the pointer settles or the tab is hidden.

entries.title: Filters move into a left side rail
items: Site layout: search, group and status filters now sit in a rail on the left of the catalog — sticky on desktop and collapsed or expanded with the Filters button.
On narrow screens the rail becomes an off-canvas drawer with a backdrop, closed by the X, the backdrop, Escape or the Show-N button; the Changelog tab hides the rail.
The rail shows live counts per group and per status chip; the desktop show / hide choice is remembered in the browser.

entries.title: Input Forwarder for Apollo streaming
items: Added BlueScorpioVR/androidInputForwarder to PC VR & Streaming: a root-only app that forwards a Bluetooth controller, keyboard and mouse to an Apollo PC while another app owns the screen.

entries.title: Stars and releases load live on the site cards
items: Site cards now fetch each repo's star count and latest release in the visitor's browser (shields.io JSON, cached 30 minutes, refreshed in the background), so both stay current with no catalog edits or rebuilds.
Release badges include prereleases now, so beta-only repos no longer show a red "no releases or repo not found" badge.

entries.title: ALVR face-tracking module, and a badge bump
items: Added compdoge/VRCFT-ALVR-UE to Face & Eye Tracking: the PC-side VRCFaceTracking receiver that pairs with gxr-root-ft.
compdoge/gxr-root-ft release badge brought up to v1.3.8.

entries.title: NEW badge and New filter brought back into sync
items: Fixed: the badge's own CSS overrode the hidden attribute, so every card wore NEW while the filter matched only the window set.
The 5-day window is now the only rule — no baseline — and the badge, the chip count and the New filter share one predicate.

entries.title: NEW badge tuned to real additions
items: The badge now starts from the catalog's new_badge_since baseline, so the initial bulk seeding is not flagged as new.
Only entries added on or after 2026-10-14, within the last 5 days, carry NEW.

entries.title: NEW badges for freshly added repos
items: Every catalog entry now records the date it was added.
The site marks entries from the last 5 days with a NEW badge and a New filter, computed in the visitor's browser so they expire on their own.

entries.title: KernelSU module source, and a renamed relay repo
items: Added compdoge/gxr-ksu-modules to KernelSU Modules: a module source the GXR manager browses under Sources.
compdoge/gxr-alvr-ft follows its rename to compdoge/gxr-root-ft, with its release badge brought up to date.

New Apps & Samples group for players, samples and small apps.

items: Added the first 25 repos across 8 groups: root and kernel tooling, KernelSU modules, PC VR drivers, app patches, emulation and diagnostics.
README, Pages site and agent docs published, all generated from catalog.json.
